description: Edit an article's text: title, slug (drafts only), teaser, featured snippet, markdown body, FAQs, meta title/description or featured image alt. Only the fields you send change; HTML, SEO score and AI-phrase flags are recomputed as in the editor. Pass get_article's contentFingerprint as baseFingerprint to refuse the write if the article changed meanwhile. Hosted Next.js blogs serve the edit automatically; for other CMSs call publish_article again when republishNeeded is true. (requires an agent API key)
